features.description: In the bonus games Marked Squares accumulate, raising the value of each Rainbow.

review:
Smokey runs a nightclub in this Le game. Winning spots become Marked Squares, and a Rainbow switches them on to reveal Coins, Buckets of Gold and Four-Leaf Clovers that boost coin values.

Three FS symbols trigger the bonuses, where Marked Squares build up across spins and give the Rainbow more to work with. Rated 3/5, 10,000x max, RTP versions of 96.34%, 94.23% and 92.17%. Same squares-and-rainbow fun as Le Bandit, new theme.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 92.17% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
